rounds.text: The company’s long-term revenue trajectory is in severe decline, evidenced by a compounded sales growth of -53% over five years and -60% over three years [E14, E15, E59]. This operational decay is reflected in consistently poor returns, with a median return on equity of just 3% over five years and a return on assets of only 0.25%, both significantly trailing sector benchmarks [E8, E25, E60]. Financial stability is a major concern as current liabilities exceed current assets with a current ratio of 0.19x, while massive contingent liabilities of Rs 182 Cr loom over a total market capitalization of only Rs 63 Cr [E3, E36, E61]. Despite some recent profit spikes, the stock appears overvalued with a P/E of 161.72x against a sector benchmark of 23.91x, and a discounted cash flow analysis suggests a negative margin of safety of -10.5% [E6, E41, E42]. Market sentiment remains weak, as the stock has delivered a negative 9% return over the last year and continues to trade below its 200-day moving average with high annualized volatility of 59.1% [E23, E50, E68]. Conceded: the company is almost debt-free with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.03x and trades at a price-to-book value of 0.43x [E35, E56, E57].
